# Credibled

> Credibled is a Canadian background check platform built in Toronto and used by employers, staffing agencies, and HR teams across Canada and the US. The platform automates criminal record checks, reference checks, ID verification, and 12+ other check types, with Canadian criminal record checks typically returned in about 15 minutes. Every account, regardless of size, gets a dedicated rep. Pricing is pay-per-check with no subscription, no minimum, and no contract.

Credibled was founded in 2020 and is headquartered at 391 Keele Street, Toronto, Ontario. It is 100% Canadian-owned and operated, PIPEDA-compliant, and hosted on AWS with SSL encryption in transit and encrypted storage at rest. Co-founders are Elvine Assouline and Brad Semotiuk. The platform serves SMBs, staffing agencies, regulated employers (defence, security, controlled goods), non-profits, and startups, and runs background checks across Canada, the US, and 200+ international jurisdictions. Pricing starts at $24 CAD for a Canada Standard criminal record check (with ID verification bundled in) and $9 CAD per reference check.

For a comprehensive single-file reference with all content embedded, including full feature descriptions, pricing tables, FAQs, and the named feature catalogue (Smart Referrals, Integrity Alerts, Bounce Alerts, Credibled Co-Pilot), see [llms-full.txt](https://credibled.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core product pages

- [Why Credibled](https://credibled.com/why-credibled/): Detailed overview of differentiators including a dedicated rep on every account, ID verification bundled into the criminal check price, duplicate detection across recruiters, Smart Referrals (lead generation through reference checks), and 15-minute Canadian criminal record turnaround. Includes full FAQ.
- [Background Check for Business](https://credibled.com/background-check/): Main B2B background check product page covering all check types, pricing, and use cases.
- [MyCheck: Personal Canadian Criminal Record Check](https://credibled.com/personal-criminal-record-check/): Consumer product for individuals who need a personal criminal record check, such as for employment, volunteering, or licensing. Level 1 $39 CAD, Level 2 $49 CAD, among the lowest-cost certified consumer options in Canada.
- [Background Screening API](https://credibled.com/background-screening-api/): Developer API for embedding Credibled background checks directly into an ATS, HRIS, or custom hiring workflow. Supports criminal checks, reference checks, ID verification, and more.

## Core checks

- [Criminal Record Verification](https://credibled.com/criminal-record-verification/): Canadian Standard (RCMP CPIC) and Enhanced (CPIC + PIP + Niche) criminal record checks, with ID verification included. Approximately 15-minute turnaround for Canadian checks. US criminal checks available at Base, Single County, and Unlimited levels.
- [Identity Verification](https://credibled.com/identity-verification/): Document and biometric ID verification supporting 13,500+ ID types worldwide, including passports, driver's licences, and national ID cards. Supports non-Latin alphabets with live upload guidance.
- [Reference Verification](https://credibled.com/reference-verification/): Fully automated digital reference checks at $9 CAD per candidate (covers all references for that candidate, not per reference). Includes four named features at no extra cost: Smart Referrals (lead generation), Integrity Alerts (fraud detection across IP and device), Bounce Alerts (real-time email rejection notifications and typo catching), and Credibled Co-Pilot (compliant questionnaire generation from job title, competencies, and industry). SMS and email outreach with 24-hour reminders for up to 10 days.

## Employment, education, and credentials

- [Employment Verification](https://credibled.com/employment-verification/): Confirms candidate work history including position and dates. Three to five contact attempts over three business days per employer. Current employers contacted only with explicit candidate consent.
- [Education Verification](https://credibled.com/education-verification/): Verifies degrees, diplomas, and dates of attendance from institutions worldwide.
- [Credential Verification](https://credibled.com/credential-verification/): Verifies professional licences, certifications, and designations.

## Risk signals

- [Drivers Record Check](https://credibled.com/drivers-record-check/): Driver abstracts across Canadian provinces and US states for roles involving driving responsibilities.
- [Credit Checks](https://credibled.com/credit-checks/): Soft credit checks for positions involving financial responsibility or fiduciary duty.
- [Public Records Search](https://credibled.com/public-records-search/): Civil litigation, judgement, and public records searches.
- [Social Media Background Checks](https://credibled.com/social-media-background-checks/): AI-based social media screening flagging hate speech, bullying, violence, drug use, and custom keywords. Only flagged content appears in the report. Not available in Québec.

## International coverage

- [International Background Checks](https://credibled.com/international-background-checks/): Criminal record and identity checks across 200+ international jurisdictions, with one platform, one invoice, and one dedicated rep regardless of candidate location.

## Pricing and programs

- [Pass-through Access Fees](https://credibled.com/pass-through-access-fees/): Transparent at-cost pass-through fees for education verification, employment verification, and US criminal court access fees. Canadian criminal record checks have no pass-through fees.
- [Startup Program](https://credibled.com/startup-program/): Tailored pricing for high-growth early-stage companies with reduced rates on criminal record checks and reference checks. The only Canadian background check platform with a dedicated startup program.
- [NGO Program](https://credibled.com/credibled-ngo-program/): 50% off reference checks at $4.50 CAD per check, plus discounted rates on criminal record checks. For registered non-profits screening volunteers and staff at scale.

## Integrations and add-ons

- [Google Workspace Add-on](https://credibled.com/google-workspace-add-on/): Run background checks directly from Gmail and Google Workspace.
- Native ATS and HRIS integrations: Bullhorn, JobAdder, Vincere. New integrations added regularly.
